_comment: Synthetic, and not the composite scenario: a separate invented incident with no counterpart in the archive. See SCENARIO.md for the sanitisation rules. Forcing input for the refusal demo (docs/precedent-analyst.md phase 3): the correct answer is no_applicable_precedent with search coverage populated.
symptom: Consumers of the order events stream are reconnecting in a loop. Queue depth is climbing on two of six broker nodes. No messages have been lost and no consumer has reported an error to its callers.

problems.title: Mutual TLS session establishment failing between broker and consumers

signals.note: The broker cluster's service certificates were reissued under a new intermediate authority on 2026-04-13. The consumer fleet's trust bundle was last distributed 2026-02-02.

evidence.description: Broker log records handshake failures from 04:20, each terminating during the certificate exchange.
evidence.establishes: the failures are at session establishment, not after it
evidence.does_not_establish: which peer rejects, or on what grounds

missing_evidence.description: Packet capture of one failing handshake from a consumer host, showing which peer sends the alert and at which step of the exchange.
missing_evidence.how_to_obtain: Capture on a consumer host during a reconnect attempt and decode the handshake.
missing_evidence.note: Deciding evidence. Everything before it is inference.
